title: Strategic Delegation: A Modular and Hybrid Architecture for LLM Agents playing Slay the Spire

contributions.purpose: 实证五种LLM智能体架构对比
contributions.mechanism: 在完整Slay the Spire上跑单体/记忆增强/启发式/混合战斗/模块化五设置(GPT-4o三段流水线)
contributions.evaluation: 单体LLM意外稳健(平均推进2-21),反驳'纯LLM在复杂战术必脆弱'的前提
contributions.source_quote: The baseline monolithic LLM agent demonstrates a surprisingly robust performance, consistently progressing deep into the game's second act and refuting the notion that pure LLM agents are inherently brittle.

contributions.mechanism: 在单体基础上加'最近10步'无结构短期记忆缓冲
contributions.evaluation: 反直觉负结果:性能崩塌至平均1-17(vs单体2-21),成最差架构
contributions.source_quote: augmenting this competent baseline with a simple, unstructured short-term memory buffer proves to be severely detrimental, resulting in a significant performance collapse.

contributions.mechanism: 启发式负责地图导航,LLM专注随机性强的战斗决策
contributions.evaluation: 混合战斗专家最优(平均2-27,最高2-33);模块化提升峰值(达2-33)但均值仅2-22,与单体持平
contributions.source_quote: The Hybrid Combat Specialist, which delegates combat decisions to the LLM while using heuristics for navigation, achieves the highest average performance.

self_declared_provenance.quote: This work builds upon a publicly available community modification of the game. We extend the original repository by introducing additional player settings.

notes: 少见的真实实证工作(基于开源社区mod扩展)。核心含反直觉负结果与trade-off:无结构短期记忆使性能从2-21崩到1-17;模块化提峰值不提均值。数据红旗:样本极小(正文/图仅展示Game 1、Game 2两局),Table 2只给Max/Avg两点无误差棒,但Paper Checklist却答'统计显著性:Yes(多轮实验减方差)''误差棒:Yes'——声称与呈现不符;§4.1提到'corrected Table 2'且checklist承认存在'mapping experimental data to agent settings'的事后推断(数据到设置的对应靠推测);摘要结尾有复制粘贴残留的重复病句('...diverse cognitive components.strategic delegation through...')。checklist写作项自报[D](AI生成),其余[C]。
